description: JVM descriptor and cross-feature integration join (ISSUE-0110). These fixtures run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed; the multi-module fixtures additionally run the real CompilationOrchestrator pipeline). Covered forms: nested descriptors (?[int], [?int], ?[Pt], [?Pt], ?[?int]) through function parameters and returns; nullable arrays and classes through parameters/returns; function signatures combining arrays, classes, and nullability ([int], ?Pair, ?[string]); imported nominal classes in descriptors (param p: @lib/Point, let i: @lib/Item); deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostics pinned byte-for-byte at the single shared descriptor-driven $check(descriptor, value) seam ('expected int, got String', 'expected instance of @Main/B, got @Main/A', 'expected array, got __StringArray' at [int] and ?[int] gates, 'expected instance of @modelb/Item, got @modela/Item' across modules); the table branch; and a stdlib boundary (std/string results flowing into nullable locals). Three IR-layer fixtures pin the descriptor forms whose runtime lanes land later: the nested array [[int]], the async completion descriptor async(int)->string with the async-completion boundary, and the function-type descriptor ([int],?@mod/User)->?@mod/User.

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-nullable-int
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: a string value crossing an int | null table-read boundary raises E8001 with the exact message 'expected int, got String' and exit 1

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-nullable-class
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: an A instance crossing a B | null table-read boundary raises E8001 naming both module-qualified identities ('expected instance of @Main/B, got @Main/A') and exit 1

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-array-wrapper
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: a string[] wrapper crossing an int[] table-read boundary raises E8001 'expected array, got __StringArray' and exit 1 (the [int] branch gates on the emitted wrapper)

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-nullable-array-gate
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: a string[] wrapper crossing an int[] | null table-read boundary raises E8001 'expected array, got __StringArray' and exit 1 (the ? prefix passes only the DEAL null before the [int] gate)

tests.name: jvm-join-table-desc
tests.description: Cross-feature join: a nested table round-trips through the shared seam's table branch (descriptor 'table') — the table-typed read passes the gate and the artifact runs

tests.name: jvm-join-stdlib-nullable-boundary
tests.description: Cross-feature join at a supported stdlib boundary: std/string results flow into nullable locals and narrow for the arithmetic/equality checks (str.length('abc') = 3, str.substring('abcdef', 2, 4) = 'cd' → 3 + 1 = 4)

tests.name: jvm-join-xmod-class-descriptor
tests.description: Cross-feature join across modules: an imported nominal class appears in descriptors — the entry-local function's parameter spells the spec class descriptor @lib/Point in the IR, the value flows in and out of an entry-local function, and the field reads back (7)

modules.lib.deal:
export class Point { x: int = 0; }
export function make(x: int): Point { return { x: x }; }

tests.name: jvm-join-xmod-table-read-desc
tests.description: Cross-feature join across modules: an imported nominal class crosses the untyped table boundary — the read dispatches on the DECLARING module's shared seam with the spec class descriptor @src/Item (the IR spells the resolved read type @src/Item) and the field reads back ('x')

modules.lib.deal:
export class Item { tag: string = ""; }
export function make(tag: string): Item { return { tag: tag }; }

tests.name: jvm-join-xmod-mismatch-desc
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam across modules: a modela.Item instance crossing a modelb.Item table-read boundary dispatches on the declaring module's seam and raises E8001 naming both module-qualified identities ('expected instance of @src/modelb/Item, got @src/Item') and exit 1

modules.modela.deal:
export class Item { tag: string = ""; }
export function make(tag: string): Item { return { tag: tag }; }
